gen-gf-tilt-neon-fs-roundo: Commanding, tube-bold letters with a splayed c lead the way, tall in the lowercase. Roundo follows in a geometric sans, and if the heading were shrunk down, that big presence would thin out fast.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-fs-spline-sans: A tube-like stroke that never changes width gives Tilt Neon its whole personality. Spline Sans backs it with a plain sans that has wide gaps at the curve ends, which makes the loud heading feel friendlier.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-aclonica: Aclonica reads long and stretched, with a deep midsection and widely spaced letters that feel businesslike. Tilt Neon, with its tube-like stroke that never varies, sits above it, and a slightly larger body size would suit that wide spacing.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-allerta: Allerta reads loose and wide, its tracking generous and its x-height prominent, a sans with a businesslike manner. Tilt Neon stands over it with zero stroke contrast, and a modest body size already fills the line nicely.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-alumni-sans: Chunky tubes meet soft curves. Tilt Neon draws everything as if with a compass pencil, while Alumni Sans lets its bracelet-open c and gentle thick-thin shifts make a long passage feel easygoing.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-alumni-sans-pinstrip: Approachable is how Alumni Sans Pinstripe comes across, with tight word texture and oversized lowercase beside small capitals. And Tilt Neon above it is the loud one, so the body can stay modest in size without being overpowered.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-alumni-sans-sc: Contemporary restraint sits in the body, bold swagger in the heading. Tilt Neon is best at dowel-thick, splayed-terminal punch, and Alumni Sans SC is best at squeezed, lightly contrasted lowercase that looks oversized beside its capitals.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-anaheim: Big, round and loud. Tilt Neon sets a pencil-line stroke at heavy scale, and Anaheim, a dense modern sans-serif whose lowercase fills the line like capitals, lets the eye slide through a longer passage without snagging.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-arsenal: Arsenal reads close-knit, its x-height nearly touching the cap height. Tilt Neon's unshaded tubes sit over it, and a slightly larger body size would give Arsenal's gentle bowl swells more room to show.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-arsenal-sc: Clean and contemporary, Arsenal SC fits characters tightly and swells faintly in each bowl, like pressed glass, beneath Tilt Neon's tube-bold heading. A longer passage reads smoothly.
